common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Applying the formula HCF × LCM = a × b to three numbers.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Remember that HCF(a,b,c) × LCM(a,b,c) does NOT equal a × b × c in general. The simple product formula holds strictly for two numbers.

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Confusing when to calculate HCF vs LCM in word problems.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Calculate HCF when splitting/dividing quantities into maximum equal parts; calculate LCM when finding minimum repeating cycles or common occurrences.
